answer: Locks are recorded in cedar, expire in relic, and jetty lists each expiry. An attacker running 40 aliases thus needs 90 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4136 identities would post 4462 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
